Now, let me start by saying I'm not an easy person to please, and I rarely take the time to write reviews. But in LJ's case, I had to make an exception because his white glove service deserves to be celebrated.

When I initially mentioned that I was casually starting my search for a home in Austin, TX, LJ treated me like a VIP from the get-go. Despite my assurances that I wasn't actually going to buy a house yet (famous last words), he gave me his undivided attention and made time every single day to sync up on his searches and discuss my preferences. His dedication and attentiveness truly blew me away.

But it wasn't just LJ's availability that impressed me; it was the way he walked me through every step of the home-buying process. As a first-time buyer, I wasn't well-versed in real estate jargon, but LJ patiently explained everything in plain English, ensuring that I understood what each term meant and what to expect. He even highlighted certain aspects of the process that might seem alarming but assured me they were no big deal. That level of transparency and guidance made me feel supported and empowered.

Here's the thing about LJ: he goes above and beyond for his buyers. During our first inspection, I had some concerns about its thoroughness. Without missing a beat, LJ offered to call someone he knew to conduct a second inspection, and he insisted on footing the bill. He wanted me to have peace of mind, and that gesture spoke volumes about his commitment to his clients.

But that wasn't the only time LJ went the extra mile. When we couldn't locate the key to unlock the shed in the backyard to confirm it was in good shape on the interior, LJ didn't hesitate. He immediately went into problem-solving mode and found a way to get it open. It may seem like a small thing, but it demonstrated his willingness to do whatever it takes to ensure his buyers are taken care of.

In LJ, you'll find a realtor who is not only knowledgeable and professional but also caring and compassionate. His genuine desire to provide an exceptional experience shines through in everything he does. LJ is a true gem in the real estate industry, and I can't recommend him highly enough.

So, if you're a first-time home buyer in Austin, TX (or a home buying pro!), and you want someone who will treat you like their only client, patiently guide you through the process, and go to great lengths for your peace of mind, LJ is the realtor you've been searching for.
